# Web Digital Development

> Web Digital Development is a Delhi-based website design, development and SEO company. Founded by Gudia Yadav in Palam, New Delhi, the studio has delivered 150+ websites for clients across India and abroad. We build modern, responsive, conversion-focused websites and help businesses rank on Google and grow.

## About

- Name: Web Digital Development
- Founder: Gudia Yadav
- Location: Palam, New Delhi, Delhi 110045, India
- What we do: Custom website design, website development, SEO, e-commerce stores, and digital marketing for small and medium businesses.
- Track record: 150+ websites delivered; rated 4.9/5 by 130+ clients.
- Typical delivery: Landing pages go live in 3–5 days; business websites in 5–7 days; e-commerce in 10–15 days; redesigns in 5–7 days (larger/e-commerce 10–15). Every project includes 15 days of free support.

## Services

- [Website Designing](https://webdigitaldevelopment.com/services/website-designing) — Custom, conversion-focused, mobile-first website design.
- [Website Development](https://webdigitaldevelopment.com/services/website-development) — Fast, secure, scalable websites and web apps.
- [SEO Services](https://webdigitaldevelopment.com/services/seo-services) — On-page, technical and local SEO to rank higher on Google.
- [Digital Marketing](https://webdigitaldevelopment.com/services/digital-marketing) — Google Ads, Meta Ads, content and email that drive growth.
- [E-commerce Development](https://webdigitaldevelopment.com/services/ecommerce-development) — Online stores that sell, ship and scale.

## Service areas

Delhi, New Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon (Gurugram), Faridabad, Ghaziabad, and across India. We also work with international clients remotely.
